name: What common challenges occur during a room expansion?

mainEntity.name: What common challenges occur during a room expansion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during a room expansion include unexpected structural issues in the existing home, delays in obtaining permits from local authorities, unforeseen site conditions (like difficult soil), weather-related disruptions, and budget overruns if initial estimates aren't comprehensive. Effective communication with your contractor and a contingency budget can help mitigate these challenges.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include structural issues, permit delays, site conditions, weather, and budget overruns.
